left.proxy: centroid of per-frame lowest 5mm of vertices dominated by foot/toe groups

right.proxy: centroid of per-frame lowest 5mm of vertices dominated by foot/toe groups

interpretation_limits: Foot/toe axes are measured from rig bones; rest-axis offsets are reported separately and are not automatically corrected.
Arm direction errors compare upper-arm and forearm bone directions; this does not judge whether the motion looks natural.
Stance width is normalized to the inter-UpLeg-head distance; different rig proportions can affect this ratio.
Foot contact speeds use the lowest 5mm of a per-frame foot/toe vertex subset and are only a proxy because the lowest vertices can change as the sole rolls.
